question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word with reference to its usage in the passage.**

Debilitating
solution:
The correct answer is: **Invigorating**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**debilitating**" in the passage is used to describe certain weaknesses of traditional Indian firms, suggesting that these weaknesses are debilitating, meaning they make the firms less effective or hinder their performance. (कम प्रभावी या उनके प्रदर्शन में बाधा)
 
• In the context of the passage, **the most appropriate antonym** for "**debilitating**" would be "**invigorating**."
 
• "**Invigorating**" means to give strength, energy, or vitality. (ऊर्जा या जीवन शक्ति देने के लिए)
 
• So, in the opposite sense, weaknesses that are invigorating would enhance or strengthen the performance of the firms, which contrasts with the negative impact implied by the term "debilitating" in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Enfeebling: **Weakening or making someone or something feeble, physically or mentally. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को शारीरिक या मानसिक रूप से कमजोर करना)
 
• **Crippling: **Causing severe damage or impairment, often rendering something or someone unable to function effectively. (गंभीर क्षति या क्षति पहुंचाना, अक्सर किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को प्रभावी ढंग से कार्य करने में असमर्थ बना देना)
 
• **Undermining: **Gradually weakening or eroding the foundation, support, or strength of someone or something, often through subtle or indirect means. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की नींव, समर्थन या ताकत को धीरे-धीरे कमजोर करना या नष्ट करना)
